metadata.description: Cost-optimized .NET (Core + Framework), PostgreSQL, and SQL Server plugins for Claude Code: thin skills that load only when invoked, Haiku executors for exploration, git, build/test, and MCP work.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Haiku executors (scout, runner), a Sonnet reviewer for large diffs, and one-time cost setup. Required by the other plugins.

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: The full .NET SDLC for any repo (SDK-style and legacy .NET Framework): brainstorm, analyze, spike, plan, implement, tests, build, review, debug, PR and PR comments, CI, audit, plus a gated end-to-end flow.

plugins.name: postgresql
plugins.description: PostgreSQL query tuning, indexes, schema review, live schema audit with fix migrations, lock-safe migrations, and diagnostics via read-only psql.

plugins.name: sqlserver
plugins.description: SQL Server live schema audit with fix migrations (EF Core or SQL) and migration safety review via read-only sqlcmd.

plugins.name: dotnet-legacy
plugins.description: WebForms and .NET Framework 4.x modernization: inventory, target choice, and phased migration plans.

plugins.name: docs-kit
plugins.description: Confluence pages (API docs, ADRs, runbooks, release notes, QA guides) from the codebase and Jira ticket intake via an isolated Haiku publisher.
